items.headline: Moody's warns AI lending is pushing private credit toward refinancing risk
items.note: A cluster of 2027-2029 loan maturities could leave weaker AI-linked private-credit borrowers unable to refinance.

items.headline: CoreWeave 5-year CDS above 1,000 bp, implying a >60% five-year default probability
items.note: Spreads above 1,000 bp signal market-priced distress for the largest neocloud borrower, which carries roughly $35B+ of debt.

items.headline: Oracle CDS widens to ~315 bp after record 288 bp, trading like high yield
items.note: Oracle is rated BBB- (one notch above junk) and its CDS is pricing closer to BB/B credit as AI buildout debt grows.

items.headline: Banks reportedly shopping Oracle-linked AI data center construction debt as order books thin
items.note: Underwriters struggling to distribute data-center loans would point to weakening syndication demand; secondary source, dating and figures unverified.
